disputed: The administration says it prioritizes compliance assistance and 'cooperative federalism' over litigation, and that enforcement numbers are cyclical. Administrative penalties ($41 million through Sept 2025) were closer to prior levels than lawsuit counts were.

items: DOJ filed only 16 civil enforcement lawsuits for EPA in the first year: 76% below Biden's first year, 81% below Trump's first term, and 87% below Obama's second. Settlements fell to 40 in 2025, compared with 112 in 2021 and 186 in 2013. Of about 700 facilities with high-priority air violations, only 12% faced enforcement. (Environmental Integrity Project (https://environmentalintegrity.org/news/environmental-enforcement-plummets-in-the-first-year-of-trumps-second-term/))

DOJ's Environment and Natural Resources Division was renamed the Energy and Natural Resources Division in June 2025 and lost over 25% of its staff. The Environmental Crimes Section shrank from 42 attorneys to about 21, the Environmental Justice Office closed in February 2025, and four section chiefs were involuntarily reassigned. (Inside Climate News (https://insideclimatenews.org/news/28072026/justice-department-environmental-enforcement-has-collapsed/))
sections.label: Documentation

summary: Federal civil lawsuits against polluters fell to record lows in Trump's second term. DOJ's environmental division has been shrunk, renamed to drop 'environment,' and staffed in part with industry lawyers.
title: Collapse of environmental enforcement against polluters
